extracted.name: Orange Dream Punch
extracted.description: This is the easiest punch recipe ever. It was a big hit at my sister's bridal shower. Simply pour ginger ale over orange sherbet and orange juice concentrate.
ingredient_lines: 1 (6 ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
instruction_lines: Place sherbet and frozen orange juice concentrate in a punch bowl. Allow to thaw for 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in ginger ale.
